faqs.a:
Different access may be approved or required by the traffic engineer where, due to
               unusual streets, terrain, access or property usage conditions, access as provided
               in this article would be unsafe or inadequate. Under such circumstances, access will
               be approved which conforms as closely as practicable to this article, while providing
               for safety and adequacy of access.
(Code 1981, § 30-142; Ord. No. 1544, § 4(B), 3-19-1979)
